case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). Fallback if you walk away: today's terms continue unchanged. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to submit our offer for your consideration. We can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, and a contract term of 12 months.

As a valued partner, we always strive to support your operations with our extensive inventory and reliable delivery service. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our successful business relationship and standing by as your trusted partner for all your supply needs.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You wrote that you want to support our operations with reliable delivery and an extensive inventory. Our options give that plant a steady, binding load over a longer term: business on top of what you supply us today, and Option A secures it.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On our past orders of the bolt:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

And of the nut:
Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.13; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives your plant the binding volume over the full contract term, and it is the simplest one for both family companies to put in place.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

Since price decisions on your side may need approval beyond your desk, I would ask you to take Option A to the person who decides. It brings your company a binding volume over a long term and a steady load for your plant, at a price we can stand behind. We would be glad to build on this long cooperation together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. While we acknowledge the historical price stability you cited, our pricing must reflect current market conditions. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

As the authorized representative for this negotiation, I have reviewed your proposals and we can agree to the 24-month term and 45-day payment period from your Option B. Factoring in your volume commitment, we are pleased to offer a revised price of €5.58 per unit for this package. 

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Alternatively, we offer a price of €5.58 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €5.58 per unit.

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
messages.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You asked about volume, and that is exactly what Option A answers: a binding annual volume over a longer term, business on top of what you supply us today, which gives your plant a steady load.

We are glad you took our volume argument into account.

Our orders of Washer ISO 7089 M12, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2024-10-10 (po:4500011536-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2025-06-11 (po:4500012581-10), EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-01-29 (po:4500013501-10) and EUR 12.78 per 1,000 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-20): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.19; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.21; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.25; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it pairs the binding volume with a unit price that fits the price record above.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Since a price decision of this kind may need sign-off on your side, we would be grateful if you would take Option A to the person who decides there, and let us know the outcome.

We would like to settle this as a fair solution for both family companies.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We have reviewed the price history for the washers you cited; while the data is correct, it does not change our calculation for this specific bundle. Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. We appreciate your commitment to a binding volume of 30,000 units per year over the 24-month term, which we have factored into our pricing. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.60 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This offer is valid for 30 days.

Building on your Option A, we can offer a revised price of €5.55 per unit with 45 days net payment terms and a 24-month contract. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Option B: unit price EUR 5.26; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve: it gives your plant the most secure volume, and the delivery record above supports a price at this level.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As this is a decision beyond your own desk, we would ask you to take Option A to the person who decides on pricing at your company, so that we can settle this as two family-minded companies with a fair result for both.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Thank you for accepting our final offer. We can accept your terms and await your order.

We are pleased to confirm the agreement at a price of €5.49 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, and a contract term of 24 months. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

We look forward to a successful continuation of our partnership. Our offer stays valid for 14 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
